name: Exp_BlauTVI
summary: This EA trades based on the BlauTVI (Trend Vigor Index) indicator developed by William Blau. It generates buy signals when the indicator rises (value increasing) and sell signals when it falls (value decreasing), with separate controls for opening and closing positions. The EA uses triple-smoothed momentum to identify trend vigor and executes trades on new bar formation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于William Blau的BlauTVI（趋势活力指标）进行交易。当指标上升时产生买入信号，指标下降时产生卖出信号，并分别控制开仓和平仓操作。EA使用三重平滑动量来识别趋势活力，并在新K线形成时执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于BlauTVI（趋势活力指标），这是一个由William Blau提出的三重平滑动量指标。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标从下降转为上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值继续上升）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（指标从上升转为下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前值继续下降）时开空仓。出场条件分为主动平仓和止损止盈平仓两种，主动平仓在反向信号出现时触发，止损止盈则通过StopLoss和TakeProfit参数控制。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持固定手数和百分比两种模式。资金管理采用MMMode参数选择LOT或其他保证金模式，默认0.1表示使用10%的资金进行交易。策略使用了XMA_Method平滑方法选择、三段长度参数（XLength1/2/3）以及相位参数XPhase来精细调节指标平滑效果，支持EMA等多种平滑算法。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the BlauTVI (Trend Vigor Index), a triple-smoothed momentum indicator proposed by William Blau. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator turning from decline to rise) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value continuing to rise); a sell signal is generated when Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator turning from rise to decline) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current value continuing to fall). Exit conditions include both signal-based closing (triggered on reverse signals) and stop-loss/take-profit based closing via the StopLoss_ and TakeProfit_ parameters. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which manages the capital ratio, supporting both fixed lot and percentage-based margin modes. Money management uses the MMMode parameter to select between LOT and other margin modes, with a default of 0.1 meaning 10% of capital is used for trading. The strategy employs configurable smoothing via XMA_Method, three length parameters (XLength1/2/3), and a phase parameter XPhase to fine-tune the indicator's smoothing behavior, supporting EMA and other smoothing algorithms.

parameters.description_en: Money management: negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式，LOT为固定手数模式

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型，tick量或真实量
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick or real volume

pros: 使用BlauTVI三重平滑动量指标，能有效过滤市场噪音，信号质量较高
开仓和平仓信号分离控制，灵活性高，可以只开不平或只平不开
具备止损止盈机制，风险可控，止盈为止损的2倍，盈亏比合理
pros_en: Uses the BlauTVI triple-smoothed momentum indicator which effectively filters market noise and provides higher quality signals
Separate controls for opening and closing positions offer high flexibility, allowing open-only or close-only configurations
Includes stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms with a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, providing sound risk control
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点设置过大，在多数品种上可能导致较大亏损
缺乏移动止盈机制，趋势行情中可能无法充分捕获利润
没有持仓检查和重复开仓保护，可能在同一信号上多次开仓
cons_en: The 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit are excessively large for most instruments, potentially leading to significant losses
Lacks a trailing stop mechanism, which may prevent capturing full profit in trending markets
No position check or duplicate order protection, potentially opening multiple positions on the same signal
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同一方向重复开仓
添加移动止盈功能，在趋势行情中锁定更多利润
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Implement a trailing stop feature to lock in more profits during trending markets

risk_points: 止损止盈点数过大（1000/2000点），实际资金风险较高
缺少持仓检查，可能导致同方向重复开仓增加风险敞口
risk_points_en: Stop-loss and take-profit values are very large (1000/2000 points), posing significant capital risk per trade
Lack of position checking may lead to duplicate entries in the same direction, increasing risk exposure
